clue.text: Month and year in which to take on one kind of state

indicators.note: the month-and-year string takes the next word inside it

parts.note: March is a month of the year
taken as written

explanation.surface: A calendar note about the moment a country adopted a new form of government.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarchy is a state ruled by a king or queen, one form a country can take.

clue.text: Intensity of feeling produced by race

definitions.meaning: first meaning: passion
second meaning: a qualifying round of a race

explanation.surface: Passion stirred up by a contest or by questions of ethnicity.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat names both strong emotion and a preliminary round in a sprint or swimming competition.

clue.text: Guinea inferior to former French colony? That's slander

indicators.note: in a down clue, being lower places this piece beneath the colony

parts.note: Mali in West Africa was part of French West Africa
GN is the international country code for Guinea

explanation.surface: A jibe ranking one West African state below another, called out as defamation.
explanation.walkthrough: Guinea here is the country, not the old coin, so it gives its two-letter code rather than G.
explanation.definitionFit: To malign someone is to speak ill of them falsely, a verb synonym of slander.

clue.text: Something needed before formulating sentence, found in whatever dictionary

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of the two words that follow

parts.note: the answer runs across the end of whatever and the start of dictionary

explanation.surface: A writer's tip that any dictionary holds what you need before building a sentence.
explanation.walkthrough: The sentence is a judicial one, not a grammatical one: a court reaches its finding before the judge passes sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A jury's finding of guilty must come before a judge can pass a punishment on the accused.

clue.text: Permit, or punitively deter, second name appearing in deed

indicators.note: the abbreviation for name shows up inside the word for deed

parts.note: a deed is an action

explanation.surface: A legal note on whether a deed authorises or penalises, with a second name entered in it.
explanation.walkthrough: The word is its own opposite: it means both to approve and to impose a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanction can mean official approval or a penalty imposed to deter, two contrary senses of one word.

clue.text: Following explosion initially in light on ceiling, not flammable or inflammable

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece on another sits above it
the opening letter of explosion goes inside the word for light

parts.note: a lamp is a light

indicators.note: only the opening letter of explosion is used

parts.note: its opening letter is the one taken
a roof is the ceiling over a space

explanation.surface: After a blast near a ceiling light, a reassuring safety rating.
explanation.walkthrough: Flammable and inflammable mean the same thing, so the definition covers both spellings of the hazard.
explanation.definitionFit: Something resistant to catching fire is neither flammable nor inflammable, the two being synonyms.

clue.text: Get excited, start attack

definitions.meaning: first meaning: informally, to become enthused or aroused
second meaning: to switch on a machine
third meaning: to round on someone suddenly

explanation.surface: Getting worked up and launching an assault, like a soldier going over the top.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb covers arousing interest, switching on a device and rounding on someone aggressively.

clue.text: Complicated kind of relationship the Oval Office finally sorted out

indicators.note: the letters are rearranged, as though put in order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: only the last letter of Office is used

parts.note: its last letter is the one taken

explanation.surface: A presidential relationship tangle that the White House eventually resolved.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oval Office reads as one name, but it splits: the Oval is fodder and Office contributes its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A love-hate relationship mixes affection and loathing, which makes it emotionally tangled.

clue.text: Nothing in striking description that's solid?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: in cricket, a side that is ... has no batsmen left in
second meaning: a total strike, solid in support

explanation.walkthrough: The two senses sit at opposite ends: total commitment, and a batting side with nobody left. A cricket team is all out when ten batsmen are dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: All-out describes total effort or a strike everyone joins, and in cricket an innings with nobody still batting.

clue.text: Fly, perhaps, one swallowed by nocturnal insectivore

indicators.note: the letter for one goes down inside the creature's name

parts.note: bats hunt insects at night

explanation.surface: A fly gulped down by a night-hunting bat.
explanation.walkthrough: The fly looks like the insect the bat eats, but it is an angler's lure.
explanation.definitionFit: Anglers use artificial flies as lures to tempt fish onto the hook.

clue.text: 10 in river shortened with stick

indicators.note: the river's name loses its last letter

parts.note: the Indus is a major river of Pakistan
cement is what makes things stick together

explanation.surface: Instructions for leaving a lure in a river with a stick.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 10, BAIT, something offered to tempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Bait is anything offered as an incentive to lure someone, the same as an incentive or lure.

clue.text: Show or conceal

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to broadcast or project a film
second meaning: to hide behind a partition

explanation.walkthrough: The word is its own opposite: one sense displays, the other hides.
explanation.definitionFit: Films are projected on a cinema surface, while a folding partition hides what is behind it.

clue.text: Self-absorbed — extra time in first half would make very little difference

definitions.meaning: a football picture, but it means an added T placed in the front half of the word
the longer word with the added letter means nearly the same

explanation.surface: A footballer so self-absorbed that extra time in the first half would hardly matter.
explanation.walkthrough: Add a T (time) in the front half and you get EGOTISTICAL, nearly a synonym, which confirms the shorter word.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wrapped up in oneself and putting oneself first is a vain, selfish trait.

clue.text: Removing or securing piece of paper

definitions.meaning: first meaning: cutting off, as in trimming
second meaning: fastening with a clip
third meaning: an article cut from a newspaper

explanation.surface: Tidying an office desk by cutting out or fastening a sheet.
explanation.walkthrough: Again a word that is its own opposite: clipping both cuts away and fastens together.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip is to snip something off or to fasten it, and a press cutting is also so named.

clue.text: My son, crazy about Big Apple either way? It means the same

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go around the city abbreviation
the letters of my son are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
nickname of New York City, so NY; either way notes it reads the same in both directions

explanation.surface: A parent's son has gone wild over New York, whichever way you look at it.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym is a word with the same meaning as another.

clue.text: Between the two of us, locate no good new striplings

indicators.note: the abbreviation for no good sits between the two pronouns
tells the solver to place the piece in that gap

parts.note: you and me are the two people meant

explanation.surface: A confidential instruction to track down some useless new youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripling is a youth, so the plural describes lads not yet fully grown.

clue.text: This, of itself, is 15

definitions.meaning: the word refers to the answer itself
the opposite-meaning term for the word at 15 is this answer

explanation.walkthrough: 15 is SYNONYM; the word for an opposite is this answer, so it is the opposite of 15.
explanation.definitionFit: An antonym is a word of opposite meaning, and opposite-meaning is the reverse of same-meaning.

clue.text: Regular but infrequent publications from unknown, first abridged

indicators.note: the word for first is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: earliest means first in time

explanation.surface: A librarian's note about periodicals arriving from an unidentified source, first in a shortened edition.
explanation.definitionFit: Annual publications come out on a regular schedule, but only once in twelve months.

clue.text: One of 16, more or less, in island

parts.note: 16 is YOUNG MEN, and a minor is a young person
ca., circa, means approximately

explanation.surface: A young man, roughly, located on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: MINORCA (Menorca) is one of Spain's Balearic Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Minorca is a Spanish Mediterranean isle in the Balearics.

clue.text: The end of some extinct creatures shown in useful reference books

parts.note: taken as written
-sauri ends the plural of dinosaur names such as ichthyosauri

explanation.surface: A museum note on what wiped out the dinosaurs, as recorded in handy reference works.
explanation.walkthrough: The end is not a last letter but a whole word ending: Latin plurals of -saurus names end in -sauri.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is a book of synonyms, a handy reference for writers; this is its Latin plural.

clue.text: Rise and fall before noon? Hell, no

indicators.note: in a down clue, this piece comes ahead of the next

parts.note: to heave is to rise and fall, as the chest or the sea does

explanation.surface: An emphatic refusal of a morning of ups and downs.
explanation.walkthrough: Hell, no reads as a flat refusal, but it means the place that is not hell, its opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise is the traditional opposite of the infernal realm, so not-hell describes it.

clue.text: Provided with food taken back to consume — best or worst

indicators.note: the word for provided with food is turned round

parts.note: fed means given food
to eat is to consume

explanation.surface: Food returned and eaten anyway, whether good or bad.
explanation.walkthrough: Best and worst look like opposites, but both are verbs meaning to beat someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To best or to worst an opponent both mean to beat them, the same verb.

clue.text: Person who's active in so many directions? Just the opposite

indicators.note: the concealed letters must be read in the opposite direction, bottom to top in this down entry
the letters are inside the run of the following words

parts.note: the answer's letters run backwards across the end of so, all of many and the start of directions

explanation.surface: An energetic person rushing about everywhere, or perhaps the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Just the opposite seems to deny the description, but it tells you to read the concealed letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynamo is an energetic, forceful person, by analogy with the generator.

clue.text: Prone to be standing up to with determination

definitions.meaning: first meaning: lying with the front turned to the ground
second meaning: confronting and refusing to back off

explanation.surface: Someone either lying flat or standing firm against an opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: Prone and standing are opposites, yet both lead to the same phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying on one's front means the face points at the floor, and to confront someone resolutely is to outstare them.

clue.text: Common complaint about antique

parts.note: C is short for circa, meaning about
old, as antiques are

explanation.surface: A frequent grumble concerning an old object.
explanation.walkthrough: Complaint here is an ailment, not a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: A runny-nosed viral infection is the most widespread minor illness.

clue.text: Fashionable, but not hot

definitions.meaning: first meaning: stylish, trendy
second meaning: moderately chilly

explanation.walkthrough: Hot is also slang for fashionable, so the clue seems self-contradicting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means stylish in slang and also slightly chilly in temperature.

clue.text: Slander American woman, European female intervening

indicators.note: the two letters come between parts of the word for woman

parts.note: dame is US slang for a woman

explanation.surface: Bad-mouthing an American woman when a European woman gets in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: To defame is to damage a reputation with false statements, a verb synonym.

clue.text: One that's not part of 1, not so unusual

definitions.meaning: first meaning: 1 is MONARCHY, and someone outside the royal family is a ...
second meaning: comparative of common, more ordinary

explanation.walkthrough: 1 is MONARCHY; a commoner is anyone not royal or noble.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-royal person is called a commoner, and the word is also the comparative of common, meaning more ordinary.
